objective: Add an architecture-compliant runtime-role in-process Cloud IaC OpenTofu module-registry composition that first matches the framework-free REST router, validates route surface metadata against the API contract, and dispatches to the pure API DTO route boundary while preserving no live HTTP listener/server, deployed endpoint, auth runtime, persistence, signing, SLSA/VSA, tofu plan/apply, provider runtime, FD-001 tenant workload hosting, or cloud provisioning claims.

best_practice_sources.what_it_establishes: OpenTofu clients discover service base URLs through /.well-known/terraform.json, including modules.v1.
The module registry protocol uses GET versions and download routes under the modules.v1 base.
Versioned registry source strings identify reusable modules; runtime credentials, serving, and provider execution are separate concerns.

implemented_claims: Added oya-cloud-iac-runtime as a workspace member and registry/catalog runtime package for Cloud IaC module-registry composition.
Runtime dispatch first matches the framework-free REST router before API dispatch, so route-level rejections happen before DTO construction.
Runtime checks REST required_surface metadata against the API surface constants before dispatching to the API route boundary.
Runtime response retains low-cardinality matched_template, captures, route-specific required_surface, and the API DTO response.

Tests cover discovery, versions, download, wrong methods, unknown paths, dot-segment captures, whitespace-mutated paths, route-specific authorization, API request-id validation, and non-claim constant.
explicit_non_claims: no live HTTP listener or Hyper server composition
no registry publish path or object-store serving
no request body parsing or live HTTP response serialization
no authentication or Cedar runtime integration beyond existing in-process authorization metadata checks
no module signing or Sigstore/cosign execution
no SLSA or VSA attestation generation
no provider runtime, provider API calls, provider credentials, or cloud provisioning
no FD-001 microservice dogfood tenant workload hosting or production tenant workload evidence
false_green_findings_closed: Closed the architecture-boundary composition gap left by the router-only REST crate: runtime-role composition is now the allowed location for rest + api dispatch.
Truth-downed prior tasks/plan wording that incorrectly said the REST-router slice dispatches into API DTOs; the REST crate remains router-only and the runtime crate owns composition.

Avoided treating in-process composition as a live module registry, deployed endpoint, auth runtime, persistence layer, signing/SLSA evidence, provider execution, FD-001 dogfood evidence, or cloud provisioning evidence.
known_gaps: Full ./bin/oya verify --ci-required is not claimed by this ChangeSet; repo-wide unrelated blockers remain outside this Cloud IaC slice.

Cloud IaC still needs future slices for an actual HTTP listener, live service discovery and module versions/download endpoints, registry publish path, object-store serving, authentication/Cedar runtime integration, database adapter, module signing/Sigstore/cosign, SLSA attestations, independent provider provenance/VSA verification, tofu tests, plan/apply evidence, provider-resource-complete modules, and live GitOps/provider integration evidence.

FD-001 remains the master-plan product delivery goal and Oyatie Cloud must later prove itself by hosting FD-001 microservices as tenant workloads; this ChangeSet provides no tenant-workload dogfood evidence.
Concurrent unrelated application-shell and other agent work exists in the worktree; this ChangeSet does not claim or modify those surfaces.
The complementary /Users/jasonlee/Developer/source/plan files informed sequencing only and are not treated as source-of-truth implementation evidence.

findings: Composition is small and explicit: one request type, one response type, one dispatcher, and no live I/O.
Adds one substrate step toward a hosted module-registry control-plane path while preserving that actual cloud/runtime/tenant hosting is not implemented yet.
FD-001 dogfood tenant workload hosting remains future proof of substrate readiness, not a claim here.
Tests force route refusal for wrong methods, unknown paths, dot-segment captures, and whitespace-mutated paths before API dispatch.
Dispatcher API keeps boundary context, authorization, method, and path explicit for future HTTP adapter handoff.
No new third-party dependencies; focused tests, fmt, check, clippy, architecture, and run-all gates passed.
Chose runtime-role crate instead of rest->api dispatch because architecture-boundaries forbids rest -> api edges and permits runtime composition.
Router kernel dot-segment refusal remains in front of API dispatch; API authz and path validation remain the second boundary.
Three static routes and in-memory registry lookup only; no network, filesystem, provider, or OpenTofu execution added.
Manifest, catalog, tasks, and evidence encode explicit non-claims and local-only scope.
Route paths and response DTO dispatch remain aligned with official OpenTofu service discovery and module registry protocol docs.
Manifest scope, tasks/plan, tasks/todo, catalog record, evidence, and audit-chain entries were updated.
Future HTTP adapter can consume the in-process dispatcher; no service operations are claimed.
Oya VCS claim used before source changes; no raw git/gh; architecture-boundaries role constraints shaped the implementation.
Official OpenTofu docs establish route semantics; repo-local gates distinguish in-process composition from live service evidence.
Explicitly excludes live endpoints, auth runtime, persistence, signing/SLSA, provider runtime, plan/apply, cloud provisioning, full verify, and FD-001 tenant workload hosting.
